remarks: Exceptionally Elegant Townhome with Ultra-Stylish Loft and Finished Lower-Level! Ideally situated less than 1-mile from Downtown Stamford's boutiques and restaurants, this 2+BR/2.5BA property delivers further convenience with a quick commute to Metro North to NYC. Emanating sophistication with classic exterior stonework and impeccable landscaping, the residence is both impressive and memorable. Designed with modern lifestyles in mind, the main level features hardwood flooring, crown molding, luminous recessed lighting, powder room, and a spacious living room. Adjoining the picture-perfect formal dining room, the eat-in kitchen boasts granite countertops, white cabinets, white subway tile backsplash, and a gas stove. Oversized for maximum comfort, the second-floor primary bedroom delights with a walk-in closet and an en suite featuring a jetted tub, separate rain shower, and dual sinks. One extra bedroom also has a walk-in closet and an attached full bathroom. Working from home is elevated to new heights in the third-floor loft, which surprises with luxurious woodwork, chic built-ins, and a meditation/reading nook. Offering even more flex space, the lower-level boasts a large family room and closet. Additional considerations include an attached one-car garage, laundry area, deck, patio, close to parks, I-95, and entertainment, and so much more! Take advantage of this rare opportunity to occupy a move-in ready townhome just steps from Downtown Stamford.
